analysis.description: The kitchen features a modern minimalist design with Shaker-style cabinetry and a muted color palette dominated by beige and white tones. The use of under-cabinet lighting enhances the space's functionality and elegance. The horizontal slatted window design, a traditional element, suggests a Northern Indian influence, blending modern aesthetics with cultural craftsmanship. Marble countertops and gold accents add a touch of traditional luxury, while the overall layout emphasizes a clean, organized space.

metadata.functionality: Primary purpose is cooking and food preparation
metadata.indian_specific: Cultural elements are subtly integrated, emphasizing a modern interpretation of traditional Indian design
